status: 30 manually scoped editorial procedures from 30 pinned source patterns; not verbatim source claims, not experimentally tested and not demonstrated improvements.

procedures.title: Resolve missing feature requirements
procedures.trigger: A requested user journey has undefined loading, failure, recovery or permission behavior.
procedures.exclude: The accepted product specification and existing tests already answer every relevant behavior.

steps.instruction: Extract actor, trigger, successful postcondition, non-goals and explicit owner choices, citing their locations.
List initialization, loading, content, empty, failure, cancellation, permission denial and recovery only where actual dependencies make them reachable.
Subtract states already specified; retain only states whose outcome changes implementation, UX or acceptance.
Seek inspectable behavior in code and standards first; formulate concise owner questions only for remaining product-value decisions.

decision_gate.question: Could missing state behavior change a user-visible outcome?
decision_gate.if_yes: Complete the unanswered contract before implementation, using the correct source owner.
decision_gate.if_no: Implement established behavior without another questionnaire.
decision_gate.discriminator: Locate a reachable state where implementations would diverge.

procedures.oracle: Acceptance flow demonstrates meaningful feedback and recovery in the relevant states.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Preserve or challenge existing architecture
procedures.trigger: A substantial feature is proposed in an established modular mobile application.
procedures.exclude: The change only edits a known local string or visual token with no new state or behavior.

steps.instruction: Record module boundaries, state holder, repository, navigation owner, error contract and existing test harness for the nearest working vertical slice.
Map new input and data ownership onto the closest existing path, identifying unmet requirements.
For each proposed new abstraction list the concrete existing contract it cannot satisfy and the user outcome it would enable.
Keep the established pattern where adequate; scope departures to the specific demonstrated gap.

decision_gate.question: Does the existing slice satisfy the new feature contract?
decision_gate.if_yes: Extend the existing implementation and its verification path.
decision_gate.if_no: Document the unmet requirement and evaluate one narrow alternative.
decision_gate.discriminator: A real new state or dependency that the existing architecture cannot represent.

procedures.oracle: Compiled integration tests show the actual feature path and no broken existing journey.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Distinguish asynchronous user-visible states
procedures.trigger: A screen depends on persisted or network-loaded data and can show stale, empty or failed results.
procedures.exclude: The view is static and has no asynchronous or cached data owner.

steps.instruction: Identify hydration state, first-load status, resolved result size, cached content, background refresh and pending save.
For each reachable state record displayed content, allowed action, announcement and failure/retry route.
Find states that show empty before hydration, erase valid stale content or lose drafts after a failed mutation.
Specify delayed initial load, resolved empty, failed refresh with cache, and failed save/retry when reachable.

decision_gate.question: Can the user distinguish unavailable data from genuinely empty data?
decision_gate.if_yes: Preserve the current truthful state machine and verify it.
decision_gate.if_no: Change the relevant UI state and retry behavior without inventing another global owner.
decision_gate.discriminator: An observed screen showing empty while data is merely uninitialized.

procedures.oracle: Installed or instrumented UI demonstrates each relevant visible state and recovery.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Measure causal debugging rather than iterate guesses
procedures.trigger: A proposed fix did not change observed behavior or a bug is intermittent.
procedures.exclude: A deterministic typo change has no runtime causal hypothesis to test.

steps.instruction: Hold inputs and environment constant and record the last observable failing postcondition.
Instrument entry and exit values of the suspected code path; verify the modification executes under the failure fixture.
Compare the failing path with a working analogue or neighboring good run and identify one differing cause.
Change one causal condition and repeat the same fixture plus a negative control; record the original false lead.

decision_gate.question: Does the modified code execute and alter the failing value?
decision_gate.if_yes: Retain the measured causal correction and run a regression.
decision_gate.if_no: Stop speculative patching; inspect upstream routing or compare a working implementation.
decision_gate.discriminator: Entry/exit instrumentation contradicts the assumed executed path.

procedures.oracle: Same reproducer fails before correction and succeeds after, without masking side effects.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Resolve uncertain remote writes without blind replay
procedures.trigger: A non-idempotent user command crosses network/account boundaries and may time out after commitment.
procedures.exclude: The operation is read-only or has a verified idempotency contract for every retry.

steps.instruction: Capture immutable environment, server, item identity, approved operation and request generation before suspension.
List pre-dispatch, dispatched, acknowledged, timed out and reconciled outcomes and the permissible side effects.
Determine whether the API supports idempotency keys, exact-target readback and safe distinction between unknown and definitely failed.
Inject timeout-after-commit, authentication denial and target changes; require exact-target readback before an uncertain replay.

decision_gate.question: Could the server have committed despite the missing reply?
decision_gate.if_yes: Reconcile the exact operation without replaying an uncertain effect.
decision_gate.if_no: Use documented safe retry only when proof establishes non-application or idempotency.
decision_gate.discriminator: Provider-side readback distinguishes committed from unapplied command.

procedures.oracle: Exactly one authorized server-side mutation, correct target, and honest uncertain UI.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Prove accessible task equivalence
procedures.trigger: A custom control, compact layout or visual status signal affects task completion.
procedures.exclude: No rendered, focusable, readable or assistive interaction can change.

steps.instruction: Record the control name, role, state, primary action, alternative action and user-visible response.
Trace the same task using supported touch, keyboard/switch, screen reader, large text and color-independent perception.
Identify controls whose meaning, focus, feedback or activation disappears in a supported mode.
Specify installed-device traversal and activation, large-text layout and accessible status announcements for affected paths.

decision_gate.question: Can each supported input mode complete the same user goal?
decision_gate.if_yes: Keep the control semantics and verify with actual assisted input.
decision_gate.if_no: Repair missing affordance, labeling, focus or layout without reducing user-required content.
decision_gate.discriminator: A supported input mode cannot reach or understand an essential action.

procedures.oracle: Task completion is observed on the supported assistive modes and viewport settings.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Profile and repair one performance mechanism
procedures.trigger: Measured user-visible latency or jank affects a concrete interaction.
procedures.exclude: No actual bottleneck is observed and the proposed optimization would only add complexity.

steps.instruction: Capture build configuration, hardware, fixture, timing or trace and the exact user transition.
Classify observed cost as state invalidation, phase ownership, rendering, I/O or other measured boundary, checking expected updates.
Choose one change predicted to reduce the identified cost while preserving correct state semantics.
Repeat the same representative transition and configuration; inspect correctness and performance before/after.

decision_gate.question: Does the proposed change remove the measured dominant cost?
decision_gate.if_yes: Keep the smallest verified repair and the baseline evidence.
decision_gate.if_no: Discard the change or reclassify the bottleneck from the new trace.
decision_gate.discriminator: Comparable baseline and after traces show no attributable change.

procedures.oracle: Same fixture shows better user-relevant latency without state loss or regression.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Audit blank spaces in a requirements concept map
procedures.trigger: A missing feature, capability or relationship is proposed based on a model gap.
procedures.exclude: A single known direct implementation path answers the question with no missing relationships.

steps.instruction: Name source classes, versions and competency questions; record missing/unsearched classes separately.
For each goal traverse actor to action to state to visible outcome and recovery, then reverse from each claimed capability.
Check missing edges against aliases, extraction omissions, schema relations, known unlinked facts, contradictions and version boundaries.
Inspect held-out sources and old/native-language prior art; only then retain a bounded, falsifiable frontier candidate.

decision_gate.question: Is the missing relation already documented but unrepresented?
decision_gate.if_yes: Repair the map and record the provenance-backed edge.
decision_gate.if_no: Keep the absence qualified; investigate a new relation without claiming world novelty.
decision_gate.discriminator: A held-out source or synonym reveals the supposed blank was not new.

procedures.oracle: Competency query, source coverage and falsifier establish a bounded model gap.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Translate acceptance into real user journeys
procedures.trigger: A feature is declared implemented because a build or isolated callback test passes.
procedures.exclude: The claim is deliberately scoped to a pure function already checked by focused unit tests.

steps.instruction: Translate each accepted user outcome into actual launch, interaction, authorized target and observable result.
Identify which tests exercise real OS picker, identity, provider, input and persistence behavior, and which merely stub them.
Select the cheapest adequate real test tier with deterministic setup, positive and discriminating negative assertions.
Run exact-revision tests and report reached assertion, environment, result and unverified coverage.

decision_gate.question: Does an executed test cross the required user-visible boundary?
decision_gate.if_yes: Treat the demonstrated scope as verified and keep remaining claims narrow.
decision_gate.if_no: Add the necessary real integration or device/provider journey.
decision_gate.discriminator: A mock succeeds but the installed user path does not reach the postcondition.

procedures.oracle: Exact-head acceptance receipt shows user-visible completion with a meaningful negative control.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Challenge a consequential decision with one serious alternative
procedures.trigger: A hard-to-reverse design has at least two plausible feasible implementations.
procedures.exclude: A small reversible change has a clearly adequate existing pattern.

steps.instruction: Write the actual goal, must-satisfy constraints, accepted tradeoff and intentionally excluded outcomes.
Remove options violating hard constraints and identify one strongest remaining rival to the initial conventional choice.
For both candidates trace normal operation and one reachable material failure, and record the observation that would reverse preference.
Run the cheapest comparable check that separates the options; preserve uncertainty and reversal rule.

decision_gate.question: Could the strongest viable alternative satisfy an overlooked hard constraint or user outcome?
decision_gate.if_yes: Choose the alternative with the observed better fit and state the cost.
decision_gate.if_no: Retain the conventional option and document its boundary of applicability.
decision_gate.discriminator: A material counterexample makes the preferred option fail the accepted outcome.

procedures.oracle: A comparable real test and explicit hard-constraint review justify the chosen option.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Adapt the layout to available space
procedures.trigger: A user-facing layout must adapt to resizable app windows or different input and text scales.
procedures.exclude: A fixed static string change does not alter layout constraints or control reachability.

steps.instruction: Record actual parent width/height limits, insets, font scale and input affordances for supported configurations rather than relying on device labels.
Identify the shortest complete arrangement that keeps essential labels, targets and feedback reachable at each content-driven breakpoint.
Find where text clips, primary action disappears, controls overlap or a wide container becomes unreadable.
Resize the actual window or supported emulator viewport and exercise touch, keyboard and large-type interaction.

decision_gate.question: Does the current layout keep essential content and actions reachable in the supported window?
decision_gate.if_yes: Preserve the existing responsive arrangement and test its boundaries.
decision_gate.if_no: Change composition or disclosure at measured constraints rather than guessing device categories.
decision_gate.discriminator: A supported window measurement proves a control becomes unreachable or text loses meaning.

procedures.oracle: Observed app windows maintain meaningful content, interactions and accessible focus at supported sizes.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Choose test machinery from the real behavior boundary
procedures.trigger: A claimed behavior needs a test and the project offers several testing tiers.
procedures.exclude: A pure function already has an adequate fast unit test for the precise claimed contract.

steps.instruction: Identify the current DI, mocking, local tests, Robolectric, screenshots, UI automation and device test conventions already in use.
Trace which system, OS, provider, identity or user action must actually be exercised for the claim to be true.
Select the cheapest existing harness that crosses the needed boundary, marking unavailable hardware or providers as untested.
Run focused checks on exact code revision and record executed assertions, skips and environment.

decision_gate.question: Can an existing test harness observe the indispensable system boundary?
decision_gate.if_yes: Use that harness and state precisely what it establishes.
decision_gate.if_no: Escalate only the uncovered behavior to instrumentation, provider or installed-device testing.
decision_gate.discriminator: A simulated callback is shown not to cover the claimed real-world effect.

procedures.oracle: Executed tests directly assert the claimed boundary with an explicit unsupported-scope note.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Choose destructive reset versus state-preserving process stop
procedures.trigger: Android testing requires a clean fixture or a process-death restoration scenario.
procedures.exclude: The task contains no process, persistence or installed-data transition.

steps.instruction: List the data that must be preserved for the test to be meaningful and what must start empty.
Choose state-erasing pm clear for fresh installation or state-preserving process termination when testing restoration, never interchange them.
Specify preconditions including whether the test runs against a disposable package and what persisted data must exist.
Read back persisted state after process stop, or confirm absence after an authorized disposable-app clear.

decision_gate.question: Is the test intended to preserve previously written app data?
decision_gate.if_yes: Kill the process without deleting its data and verify restoration.
decision_gate.if_no: Use a disposable clean-state fixture when the explicit test requires erased data.
decision_gate.discriminator: The stated test outcome depends on a record that pm clear would destroy.

procedures.oracle: Installed-device fixture exhibits the expected preserved or cleared state without touching real user data.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Preserve coroutine ownership and cancellation semantics
procedures.trigger: An asynchronous operation shares cancellation scopes or mutable state with sibling tasks.
procedures.exclude: The operation is pure and synchronous with no shared coroutine, actor or mutable collection.

steps.instruction: Record which component created each coroutine scope, who may cancel it and when its lifecycle ends.
Trace mutable writers and cancellation propagation across child jobs; identify mixed-dispatcher access and swallowed cancellation.
Find child code canceling a parent or unrelated siblings, or concurrent writes that lack confinement or appropriate synchronization.
Use controlled coroutine test dispatchers to overlap, cancel and restart tasks, checking unrelated work remains intact.

decision_gate.question: Can cancelling one task stop unrelated work or leave shared state inconsistent?
decision_gate.if_yes: Repair the ownership or cancellation boundary before depending on the asynchronous path.
decision_gate.if_no: Retain the established scope and avoid introducing synchronization without a reachable race.
decision_gate.discriminator: Controlled scheduling demonstrates a sibling is cancelled or state changes incorrectly.

procedures.oracle: Deterministic cancellation tests preserve unaffected tasks and correct observable state.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Interpret RTL navigation and gestures by their meaning
procedures.trigger: An app supports RTL text or directional controls, icons, gestures and animations.
procedures.exclude: Only non-directional images or brand assets are involved and no RTL semantics change.

steps.instruction: For each back/disclosure action identify its actual navigation destination, reading direction and content alignment rather than applying blanket visual mirroring.
Mark icons and gestures that express direction and distinguish them from non-directional imagery that should remain unchanged.
Find a mismatch where arrow direction, focus traversal or swipe motion contradicts the destination or localized meaning.
Run a real RTL locale with translated text, activate navigation and inspect focus order, animations and control semantics.

decision_gate.question: Does each RTL control convey the same destination or action as in LTR?
decision_gate.if_yes: Preserve the meaning-aware mapping and independently exercise it.
decision_gate.if_no: Correct only direction-dependent assets or gestures whose meaning is inverted.
decision_gate.discriminator: Actual RTL navigation or assistive traversal contradicts the intended destination.

procedures.oracle: Installed RTL journey follows correct navigation semantics without indiscriminately mirroring assets.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Normalize profiling conditions before optimization
procedures.trigger: A developer compares Compose performance across debug/release builds or unrepresentative configurations.
procedures.exclude: No runtime performance claim is being made and only pure logic correctness is at issue.

steps.instruction: Record debuggability, minification/profile configuration, CPU characteristics, thermal state and fixture size.
Identify differences in build/runtime settings that could dominate the observed latency independently of proposed source changes.
Specify a representative release-path baseline and controlled configuration before attributing cost to a code change.
Measure the same action under matched conditions and retain exact build variants and runtime traces.

decision_gate.question: Can the measured regression be explained by a different profiling configuration?
decision_gate.if_yes: Normalize the environment before choosing a code optimization.
decision_gate.if_no: Proceed with the already comparable measurement and search the actual bottleneck.
decision_gate.discriminator: A matched release-path test removes the alleged slowdown.

procedures.oracle: Comparable trace under appropriate production conditions supports a bounded causal claim.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Ground exploratory QA findings in installed behavior
procedures.trigger: Exploratory mobile QA is asked to find user-visible bugs or friction.
procedures.exclude: Only a static source correctness claim is requested without an available installed app.

steps.instruction: Check that the approved device/emulator, app build, automation tool version and capture commands exist before starting.
Choose bounded, user-visible interactions to explore, including their expected feedback and common failure/recovery paths.
Navigate actual flows and capture screenshots, accessibility hierarchy and logs only for issues that occurred at runtime.
For each issue retain steps, exact build/device, observed result and evidence links, separating conjectures from reproduced failures.

decision_gate.question: Was the issue actually observed in the installed app under the described conditions?
decision_gate.if_yes: Report the reproduced behavior and supporting capture.
decision_gate.if_no: Mark the concern as a hypothesis requiring a real runtime reproduction.
decision_gate.discriminator: Re-run identical steps without reproducing the alleged defect.

procedures.oracle: Device evidence supports exact user-visible issue, steps, environment and limits.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Prevent delegated work from drifting beyond source authority
procedures.trigger: Multiple agents or subprocesses are assigned research, implementation or review work.
procedures.exclude: A single authorized agent performs a contained task with no delegated write surface.

steps.instruction: Record the owner decision, repository constraints, protected files and exact action classes delegated to each agent.
Identify changes, data sources or side effects outside the authorized task and unverified research claims.
Limit implementation to approved file/behavior scope, flag genuinely new authorization needs, and preserve unresolved facts instead of filling them by guess.
Independently check actual changed files and observed test evidence against the authorized scope before integration.

decision_gate.question: Would this delegated change exceed the current owner or host-project authority?
decision_gate.if_yes: Pause only the out-of-scope mutation and request appropriate authorization.
decision_gate.if_no: Continue within the established scope without unnecessary approval prompts.
decision_gate.discriminator: A diff or command would touch a prohibited resource or perform a new external side effect.

procedures.oracle: Reviewed diff and action log remain within documented authority with truthful unverified claims.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Treat independent review findings as falsifiable hypotheses
procedures.trigger: A second agent or reviewer reports a potentially severe code defect.
procedures.exclude: The finding is already directly reproducible and confirmed against the exact latest source.

steps.instruction: Locate the actual cited code and contract at the reviewed commit, including the asserted causal path.
Classify each finding as reproduced, likely-but-unverified, false-positive or already fixed, recording which premise failed.
For consequential unfixed findings reproduce the claimed behavior or construct a discriminating test before broad changes.
Retain verified and rejected findings with evidence; apply only narrowly scoped repairs to real defects.

decision_gate.question: Does the review's factual premise hold in the latest code and reachable execution path?
decision_gate.if_yes: Use the reproducible finding to justify a targeted correction.
decision_gate.if_no: Reject, defer or correct the false premise without creating speculative blockers.
decision_gate.discriminator: The claimed call path no longer exists or cannot execute under its asserted conditions.

procedures.oracle: Source-linked review classification and an executed repro justify any change.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Feature-detect device transport before binding to it
procedures.trigger: A mobile feature depends on BLE hardware, peripheral capability or a library-specific transport.
procedures.exclude: The feature does not use the relevant peripheral or platform and can be proved locally.

steps.instruction: Record specific library version, OS permission requirements, background rules and available transport interfaces.
Check whether the actual peripheral supports the requested characteristic or feature and whether connection cleanup is required.
Map scan, connect, data exchange, failure, disconnect and reconnection only for capabilities the device actually exposes.
Exercise the real compatible peripheral and verify lifecycle cleanup, permission denial and only applicable recovery states.

decision_gate.question: Does the installed device and peripheral expose the transport operation being assumed?
decision_gate.if_yes: Use the verified capability and scoped library API.
decision_gate.if_no: Disable or adapt the unsupported operation rather than fabricating a universal transport path.
decision_gate.discriminator: Feature detection reports missing support or a real peripheral rejects the operation.

procedures.oracle: Actual supported-device exchange and disconnect are observed without leaked connection state.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Select real media test tier for codecs and DRM
procedures.trigger: A media feature claim depends on decoder, renderer, DRM, surface or actual playback behavior.
procedures.exclude: The only claim concerns a pure view-model function independent of hardware and platform rendering.

steps.instruction: Identify whether the claim concerns UI state, Android framework integration, decoder hardware, network streaming, DRM or actual playback.
Assign fake-player tests only to controlled models, Robolectric to suitable framework behavior, and instrumented/device tests to real codec or DRM boundaries.
Select small licensed deterministic test media, supported device/API and observable timeline/audio/video assertions.
Run the chosen tier, record skipped hardware/device/provider conditions and avoid declaring real playback from JVM tests alone.

decision_gate.question: Does the selected test exercise the actual media subsystem that the claim requires?
decision_gate.if_yes: Retain the scoped test and its explicitly limited claim.
decision_gate.if_no: Add the missing platform/hardware test tier before claiming full playback.
decision_gate.discriminator: A JVM fake passes but actual decoder or DRM playback fails.

procedures.oracle: Real playback behavior is observed on a compatible tested device when required.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Expose truthful app-agent API contracts
procedures.trigger: An app exports functions or intents for other agents/apps to invoke actions.
procedures.exclude: No externally callable contract is added or changed.

steps.instruction: Record each exported callable name, argument type, permission and advertised side effect alongside its real implementation.
Trace caller identity, consent, grant scope, input validation and exact target of every side-effecting operation.
Find promised operations that are unsupported, cross scope, silently fail or return success before their real postcondition.
Invoke the actual exported API with valid and invalid inputs and observe target mutation, denial, outputs and truthful failure modes.

decision_gate.question: Does the exported API promise only effects the shipping implementation can perform with valid authority?
decision_gate.if_yes: Publish the accurate contract and verify representative calls.
decision_gate.if_no: Narrow claims or correct implementation and permission checks before publishing.
decision_gate.discriminator: A real caller can trigger an undocumented effect or success without the claimed postcondition.

procedures.oracle: Installed cross-app invocation proves exact authorized effect, rejection and truthful returned status.
procedures.stop: Stop once additional source inspection cannot alter the choice or the relevant user-facing acceptance condition; record unresolved limits without asserting success.

procedures.title: Verify installed Room schema upgrades with retained data
procedures.trigger: An app update changes a shipped Room schema or database migration path.
procedures.exclude: No schema change or no preexisting persisted database can be affected.

steps.instruction: Compare old and new committed Room schema snapshots and identify stored fields that must persist.
Trace migrations registered for an already-installed version; do not substitute fresh-install schema creation.
Install an older populated build and perform a compatible-signature app update; capture actual migration behavior.
Independently read identifiers and retained data after the upgrade and document unresolved device coverage.

decision_gate.question: Does the upgrade preserve existing user records and critical preferences?
decision_gate.if_yes: Accept the migration only after retained data is independently observed on an installed upgrade.
decision_gate.if_no: Correct the migration path and repeat the installed-data upgrade test.
decision_gate.discriminator: A preupgrade populated database and postupgrade independent record readback.

procedures.oracle: Exact old-to-new installed upgrade retains records without destructive fallback.
procedures.stop: Stop when no further supported schema path changes the acceptance decision.

procedures.title: Select Android work lifetime and scheduling primitive
procedures.trigger: A task is requested to continue when its UI screen is absent or device state changes.
procedures.exclude: The task can intentionally stop when its visible UI owner ends.

steps.instruction: Record whether work is deferrable, periodic, ongoing user-visible or exact-time; map platform restrictions.
Compare supported WorkManager, foreground service, alarm and lifecycle scope behavior for this precise task.
Trace interruption, battery idle and execution quotas for the chosen target Android API versions.
Prepare stopped-UI and process-recovery observations that distinguish supported scheduling from ungrounded guarantees.

decision_gate.question: Does the chosen scheduling primitive actually satisfy the required lifetime?
decision_gate.if_yes: Retain the existing primitive and test its supported interruption semantics.
decision_gate.if_no: Change to a supported primitive and document its platform limits.
decision_gate.discriminator: A device test with the required lifetime under a realistic interruption.

procedures.oracle: Target device exercise confirms supported lifetime and truthful user-visible status.
procedures.stop: Stop when the relevant lifetime and recovery contract is verified at the required tier.

procedures.title: Audit asynchronous event migration before removing event bus
procedures.trigger: UI progress is delivered through transient global events from a background worker.
procedures.exclude: The events are already durable and correctly scoped to exact worker identity.

steps.instruction: List all event publishers, subscribers, field meanings and parallel observation mechanisms.
Resolve the exact unique work name or request identity from both producer and observer paths.
Separate running progress from final output and identify stale subscribers and duplicated event plumbing.
Plan tests for subscriber recreation, progress throttling and terminal result matching exact worker identity.

decision_gate.question: Can the screen observe the intended worker and recover after losing its subscriber?
decision_gate.if_yes: Remove only redundant global events after demonstrating equivalent scoped observation.
decision_gate.if_no: Preserve the current path until identity and terminal-state equivalence can be proved.
decision_gate.discriminator: Recreate the subscribing screen during running and terminal worker states.

procedures.oracle: Worker progress and result remain correctly identified after observer recreation.
procedures.stop: Stop once exact observer parity is established and no unreviewed publisher remains.

procedures.title: Choose minimal Compose UI test boundary by behavior claim
procedures.trigger: A Compose feature requires an assertion of semantic, visual or callback behavior.
procedures.exclude: The current executed test already proves the same behavior at the required boundary.

steps.instruction: Write the exact behavior claim and inventory test seams already present in the project.
Choose the smallest existing test seam that observes meaningfully user-facing semantic or visual behavior.
Drive controlled input and synchronize Compose state without arbitrary sleeps or changed production contracts.
Assert the visible result and preserve the executed assertions, test environment and any real-device omissions.

decision_gate.question: Does the selected test seam observe the requested behavior rather than a stub?
decision_gate.if_yes: Keep the narrow executed test and avoid unnecessary production test-only hooks.
decision_gate.if_no: Escalate only to the required UI or installed-device boundary.
decision_gate.discriminator: A controlled input produces an externally observable semantic or visual assertion.

procedures.oracle: Executed UI test demonstrates the exact user-visible contract within its stated tier.
procedures.stop: Stop when the claim is covered by the smallest sufficient executed test.

procedures.title: Preserve external state ownership in reusable Compose controls
procedures.trigger: A reusable control internally stores state that another feature may need to manage.
procedures.exclude: Local transient state is intentionally private and no caller requires synchronization.

steps.instruction: Identify each state writer, consumer and whether the public component accepts controlled value and callbacks.
Trace user action through callback, external owner update and eventual rendered value under recomposition.
Check whether a stateless core and optional convenience wrapper preserve existing public APIs and ergonomics.
Drive controlled state from outside and verify accessible interaction and the absence of divergent private state.

decision_gate.question: Can the host fully control and observe the component state without duplication?
decision_gate.if_yes: Preserve the current controlled component contract and its lightweight convenience variants.
decision_gate.if_no: Hoist the required state with a backward-compatible interface where feasible.
decision_gate.discriminator: An external state update changes the component and a user action reaches the owning callback.

procedures.oracle: Real host screen controls component value and receives user changes without state divergence.
procedures.stop: Stop once the necessary callers can synchronize without introducing duplicate ownership.

procedures.title: Keep failure diagnosis observable without leaking user data
procedures.trigger: An exception is swallowed, hidden, or ambiguously reported as successful behavior.
procedures.exclude: The branch is a deliberately expected normal outcome with no consequential failure.

steps.instruction: Trace exception, cancellation and returned status across the actual failing entrypoint.
Identify the minimum diagnostic identifiers permitted in release logs and the error shown to the user.
Separate expected errors from failure, preserve coroutine cancellation and remove only demonstrably silent catches.
Inject real failure and cancellation paths and check truthful UI feedback without sensitive data in release logs.

decision_gate.question: Can the failure be diagnosed and recovered without false success or data exposure?
decision_gate.if_yes: Retain the current bounded error path with its documented privacy constraints.
decision_gate.if_no: Correct handler visibility, cancellation propagation or redaction before claiming recovery.
decision_gate.discriminator: A reproducible exception and cancellation produces observable bounded diagnostics.

procedures.oracle: Relevant failures remain visible and release logs exclude identifying user data.
procedures.stop: Stop after the reachable failure and cancellation paths are verified and accounted for.

procedures.title: Revalidate Android permission and URI-grant authority at use time
procedures.trigger: Protected actions depend on runtime permissions or content URI grants that can expire.
procedures.exclude: The action needs no runtime or provider grant and has no authority transition.

steps.instruction: List the exact required permission, URI grant and user-intent scope for the protected action.
Trace grant acquisition, lifetime and revocation at the actual protected call rather than relying on cached booleans.
Choose authorized denial, rationale and recovery behavior only for the supported Android contract.
Revoke permission or URI grant before the call and verify no unauthorized mutation and truthful feedback.

decision_gate.question: Is authority still valid at the moment the protected operation executes?
decision_gate.if_yes: Proceed only within the actual current grant and approved resource identity.
decision_gate.if_no: Block or request permitted reauthorization without making the protected mutation.
decision_gate.discriminator: Real permission revocation between initial grant and protected invocation.

procedures.oracle: Invocation-time checks prevent unauthorized effects and preserve recoverable denial UX.
procedures.stop: Stop once approval scope, grant lifetime and denial result are observed for supported paths.

procedures.title: Reject untrusted Android intent redirection across exported boundaries
procedures.trigger: An exported component accepts external or nested intents that can influence destination or grants.
procedures.exclude: All callers and input fields are app-internal, explicitly trusted and non-exported.

steps.instruction: Record exported entries, caller authority, permissions and actual user-initiated accepted operations.
Trace untrusted nested intent data, component destinations and forwarded URI grants.
Compare an allowlisted, sanitized or rejected intent to the approved destination and supported AndroidX APIs.
Inject an unauthorized destination and grant flags, verify rejection without breaking accepted Share routes.

decision_gate.question: Can untrusted input invoke a private destination or escalate a forwarded grant?
decision_gate.if_yes: Constrain or reject the input before any launch or grant-changing side effect.
decision_gate.if_no: Preserve only tested authorized routes without unnecessary new restrictions.
decision_gate.discriminator: An externally supplied nested intent attempts a destination outside the approved allowlist.

procedures.oracle: Unauthorized intent redirection fails while approved legitimate routes continue to function.
procedures.stop: Stop when the cross-app boundary and accepted/hostile paths have independent runtime proof.
